content: Ecto v3.14.0 (released May 2026) is the current stable version. Multiple repos are supported via the :ecto_repos config key. Each repo can have a separate :priv directory for migrations isolation (e.g., priv: "priv/my_projection_repo"). Repos are started individually and can be named uniquely. ecto_sql v3.14.0 provides SQL adapters and Ecto.Migrator for programmatic migration execution. Ecto.Migrator.run/4 allows running migrations for any repo at runtime.
